description: The main stage's tokens come from emissions whose sources are empty and out of order. The projection keeps the original tokens and their sources, so head($) of a is the original Z token and text($) is its empty text. The synthetic T before Z changes neither (engine §7.4, §7.5).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage letters
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text letter
%rule letter char %emits $ :: A, $ :: A
%rule char "a"
%stage triples
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text (prefix edge)
%rule prefix A %emits ε :: X
%rule edge ($n:nothing A) %emits ε :: Y, $n :: Z
%rule nothing ε
%stage main
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text (X Y a) | (X Y b) | (X Y c)
%rule a ([+T] Z) %conditions $.source-text = "", Z ⊆ $.first-token.tags

%rule b ([+T] [+T] Z)
%rule c (T Z)
```
